set -e

mkdir -p /mnt/server/logs /mnt/server/tmp /mnt/server/modules/cloudflared

git clone https://github.com/Cheagjihvg/next-js-egg /mnt/server/gtemp
cp -r /mnt/server/gtemp/* /mnt/server/

curl -fsSL https://github.com/cloudflare/cloudflared/releases/latest/download/cloudflared-linux-amd64 -o /mnt/server/cloudflared

if [ -d "/mnt/server/modules" ]; then find /mnt/server/modules -type f -name "*.sh" -exec chmod +x {} \;; fi
